spec.assertion: Structural pin on the override clone: a `shield` effect with maxHpPct 20.59 on a `passive` block, with no finite durationSec. Fails under the nearest-wrong single-shield model (only one activation encoded) or a timed shield. Amount itself is unobservable (no HP/shield pool, no shield event kind).

Trigger-identity pin: the set of trigger kinds on shield-carrying skill1 blocks must contain BOTH 'passive' and 'burstCast', and must NOT contain 'fullBurstEnter'. Fails under the nearest-wrong full-burst-enter keying, which would re-shield on any team Full Burst she did not cast.

buffApply stat attackDamagePct value 10.41 must cover EVERY slug in totals(res) (fails under self-only), must have no finite in-fight expiresFrame and no durationShots (fails under a 'for N sec' / round-count reading), and removing it must strictly lower EVERY unit's total (non-inertness). Separately, stripping her skill1 `shield` effects must eliminate the buff entirely — the only assertion that separates the faithful requiresShielded gate from an ungated passive, since her own continuous shield makes the two numerically identical.

spec.kitLine: Full Charge attack: recover 2% Max HP
spec.assertion: Structural: skill2 must contain >=1 block with a `heal` effect, target self, trigger in {shotFired, chargeCounter}. Fails under a MISSING encoding (heal dropped as 'defensive') and under the nearest-wrong passive/fullBurstEnter trigger. The 2%-of-Max-HP magnitude is it.skip'd: no HP pool and cfg.onEvent has no heal/recovery kind.

Anti-mis-encoding: skill2 must contain no dot / flatDamage / hitRepeat / storedHit effect — 'Current HP ▼ 2% every 1 sec' is self-HP drain, not boss damage, and the DoT-encoding failure mode would silently add damage. Shield regen is it.skip'd as unobservable (no shield HP pool).

buffApply stat 'maxHpFlat' (caster-scaled % re-emits flat) with casterIdx === targetIdx === her index, value > 0, and a finite expiresFrame inside the fight — fails under a continuous encoding. Plus a hard inertness assertion: removing it leaves all four slugs' totals byte-identical, which fails under the nearest-wrong allies-wide or ATK-flavoured encoding.

spec.kitLine: All allies ATK Dmg 15.24% for 10 sec
spec.assertion: buffApply attackDamagePct 15.24 must exist (non-vacuity — proves she actually casts), cover every slug (fails under self-only), carry a finite expiresFrame and no durationShots (fails under continuous or round-count), and removing it must strictly lower every unit's total.
No `damage` event from her slot carries bucket 'skill' or 'burst'. Every kit line is a shield/heal/buff, so any skill- or burst-bucket damage is invented.

fixtures: controlComp('rapunzel-pure-grace', true) = liter (B1) / crown (B2) / rapunzel (carry slot) / helm (B3), deterministic, no seed. IMPORTANT: Rapunzel is BURST I, so in the control comp she contends with liter for the stage-1 cast and may never burst — the control comp alone cannot exercise her burst slot. All burst assertions therefore run against a second fixture where an in-memory `burstFirst` effect is injected into her override clone (skill1, passive/self) so she takes stage 1; the burst counterfactuals compare that fixture against itself so the rotation is apples-to-apples. 6 hoisted runs total: base, base minus the 10.41 buff, base minus her shields, burstFirst, burstFirst minus the 15.24 ally buff, burstFirst minus the self Max HP buff. Two shape-tolerance notes: slot blocks are read through a helper that accepts both `ov.skill1` as Block[] and `ov.skill1.blocks`, and the unmutated clone from `withPatchedOverride(SLUG, () => {})` is used for the structural pins on lines with no observable event.
gaps: it.skip — skill2-a: the 2%-of-final-Max-HP recovery AMOUNT is unobservable (v1 models no HP pool, and cfg.onEvent emits no heal/recovery event kind). Only the heal's existence, target and trigger are pinnable.
it.skip — skill2-b: shield-HP restoration (3.16% of final Max HP every 1 sec) is unobservable — no shield HP pool exists and nothing consumes shield HP.

Not asserted (no primitive): 'Full Charge maintained for MORE THAN 1 SEC' is a hold-after-full-charge dwell condition with no engine primitive; since her own shield is continuous from battle start, the gate collapses to always-true on this fixture and only the shield half of the condition is testable.

Not asserted (fixture-dependent): the tandem payload of skill2-a's heal — crown sits in the control comp with an on-recovery trigger, so rapunzel's full-charge heal may drive a teammate's buff. Removing the heal was NOT asserted to move totals because crown's own heals may already saturate that consumer, which would make either direction of the assertion unsound blind.

Shield TARGET is ambiguous in the prose ('Affects self' but 'protects all allies') and is deliberately not asserted; both encodings satisfy her own requiresShielded gate, so the divergence would be cosmetic.
